Changes against upstream commit be34af44058bbf12e39f8401e262aa44228674ae. Upstream .c/.h files are otherwise byte for byte as in the commit.

1. CMakeLists.txt (new): builds the static library selecta_sc68 from the upstream source lists. Replaces upstream's autotools build. Excludes libsc68/emu68/cc68.c (deprecated, #error) and libsc68/emu68/lines68.c (monolithic build only; the separate lineN_68.c files are used), and io68/ym_atarist_table.c and io68/ym_linear_table.c (included by ym_io.c / ymemul.c, not compiled alone). Compiles with -w and -fvisibility=hidden (vendored code is not held to the project warning set).
2. config/config.h (new, hand-written): replaces the configure-generated file. PACKAGE_*, HAVE_* for macOS and Linux. USE_REGISTRY68 is not defined, so the library never reads the Windows registry or any config file. FILE68_Z, FILE68_AO, FILE68_CURL are not defined (upstream stubs compile). FILE68_UNICE68 is defined here (upstream configure passes it as a -D).
3. config/sc68/file68_features.h (new, hand-written): replaces file68_features.h.in (removed). With FILE68_UNICE68 (set in config.h) ICE! packed SNDH files unpack through the vendored unice68 depacker.
4. libsc68/sc68/trap68.h (new, generated): the Atari ST GEMDOS/XBIOS trap emulator code that api68.c includes, normally assembled from libsc68/asm/trapfunc.s with upstream's as68 during bootstrap. Here assembled with vasm (vasmm68k_mot 2.0d, -Fbin -m68000 -no-opt) after a mechanical syntax conversion (HiSoft "name: macro { ... }" to "name macro ... endm"; version.s include replaced by VERNUM = $30000000) kept as libsc68/sc68/trap68.vasm.s; 630 bytes, dumped with xxd -i. The rendered SNDH test proves the code runs (the tune installs its timer through it).
5. libsc68/dial68/dial68.c, dial68.h copied for the "not implemented" stub; the GUI dialog sources are not copied (USE_DIALOG is undefined).
6. Not copied: see VERSION.txt.
